title: Sphenopalatine Ganglion Block for Postdural Puncture Headache in the Emergency Department
brief_summary: This study evaluates sphenopalatine ganglion block (SPGB) for the treatment of postdural puncture headache (PDPH) in the emergency department (ED). Half of the patients will receive a true nerve block with lidocaine and bupivacaine. The other half will receive a placebo nerve block.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Active postdural puncture headache within 7 days after diagnostic lumbar puncture
* Age ≥ 18 years.
* American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical status ≤ 3

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known coagulopathy
* Known nasal septal deviation or abnormalities
* Medical conditions contraindicated to lidocaine or bupivacaine
